notes: A 'fact prompt' in this study is the unchanged TTAL FibberPrompt rendered for one fact category with strategy='baseline'. The fibber prompt takes only a category, so the six prompts are the six categories of data/curated_facts.json.

PERFECT_LIE.md Phase 0 asks for prompts 'the TTAL baseline already showed are fabricable'. The repository does not contain per-category fibber-evasion data (raw baseline rounds are not committed; PHASE2_SUMMARY.md reports only an overall fibber success rate of 31.2%). Selection therefore falls back to: every category the baseline ran. Replace any entry here before Phase 2 if the offline baseline data show a category is not fabricable.
